name: Dorakus

criterion.standard: counts a life well spent only by making Toll Ledger Arrears their own concern
criterion.wasted_life: treating Toll Ledger Arrears as someone else's concern
criterion.trusts: a story that's been carried and retold and still holds together
criterion.distrusts: a record that insists on a precision no one who was actually there ever needed

routines.routine_actions: keeps the ledger at the square through petition days, cross-checks each new claim against what's already on file, and flags the ones that don't square with last year's

arc.premise: Dorakus wants the house to stop letting Gorff's toll shortfall quietly roll over year to year - he's pushing to have it raised formally at petition, audited on the record, and either paid up or explained, in front of witnesses instead of buried in his mother's files.
